findings.title: Cancellation-first makes the unconditional degradation event unrecordable
findings.requirement: PLAN §8.4 requires control degradation to always commit durably before any later receipt, while the manifest claims a closed, total legal-edge model.
evidence: IX01 may win at every reachable nonterminal tuple and changes work_cancel_state NONE->REQUESTED.
Manifest §15.5 then rejects every IH01 and IH06 row for REQUESTED, QUIESCING, CLEANING, or CANCELLED.
IX01 and IX06 fence or classify safety, but none changes HEALTHY->TELEMETRY_DEGRADED or records the generation-bound degradation/continuity fact.
The rollback-adoption repair cannot apply because every IH01-RA* guard expressly requires work_cancel_state=NONE.
adversarial_trace: Reach HEALTHY + EVIDENCE_STALE + WIDENING_RECONCILING with the exact original Effect unsettled and cancellation NONE.
Commit IX01 first, producing cancellation REQUESTED while health remains HEALTHY.
Deliver a continuity/SLO degradation before Effect settlement.
IH01-WR and every other IH01/IH06 row reject because cancellation is not NONE; no IX row durably records TELEMETRY_DEGRADED.
Later IX06 settles X/N and rollback/cleanup can proceed, but the promised degradation event and continuity ordering were never recorded.
findings.impact: The formal model contradicts its unconditional degradation durability contract. Audit/history and generation-bound continuity can report HEALTHY despite an observed control failure, or an implementation must invent an edge outside the normative manifest.
findings.required_correction: Either add an exact cancellation-side degradation-recording family for every reachable IX REQUESTED/QUIESCING safety coordinate, preserving IX rollback and cleanup ownership, or narrow the PLAN invariant explicitly and define the durable equivalent degradation receipt under IX. Race IX01/IX02 before and after degradation and Effect settlement under one tuple-version CAS.

findings.title: The IX revocation partition cannot move FROZEN or EVIDENCE_STALE candidates to REVOKED
findings.requirement: Manifest §15.2 requires revocation at every actually reachable candidate/rollout/Effect/rollback/cancellation coordinate, and §15.5 permits only IX safety rows once cancellation is pending.
evidence: The IC32 checker explicitly includes candidate source SHADOW_PASSED|FROZEN|EVIDENCE_STALE in the union of IC32 guards for cancellation NONE and IX06 synchronized revocation-safety guards for REQUESTED/QUIESCING.
IX06-UR names only candidate SHADOW_PASSED->REVOKED when revocation triggers, or candidate already REVOKED on replay/continuation.
IX06-XR likewise names only SHADOW_PASSED->REVOKED or preservation of REVOKED; IX06-NR/NQ and IX06-XQ do not supply the omitted candidate edges.
IC32-F/E would provide FROZEN|EVIDENCE_STALE->REVOKED, but ordinary candidate rows are expressly rejected while cancellation is not NONE.
adversarial_trace: Reach EVIDENCE_STALE + WIDENING_RECONCILING through IC24-A with an unsettled Effect.
Deliver a distinct authenticated revocation before settlement.
IC32-E rejects under cancellation dominance. IX06-UR may reconcile the Effect but cannot perform the required EVIDENCE_STALE->REVOKED candidate edge stated nowhere in its guard/effects.
The same hole exists for FROZEN after IX01, in X, N, or unsettled classes.
findings.impact: A valid revocation is dropped, misrepresented as mere cancellation fencing, or requires an inferred candidate transition. This falsifies the exact IC32/IX06 equality and leaves stale/frozen revocation disposition undefined during cancellation.
findings.required_correction: Add exact REQUESTED and QUIESCING synchronized IX revocation rows, or extend each IX06 X/N/UNSETTLED partition, for FROZEN->REVOKED and EVIDENCE_STALE->REVOKED. Preserve Effect/rollback identity, create no duplicate saga or cleanup, and prove exact equality and pairwise exclusion against IC32-F/E at the IX01 race boundary.
